collection.name: Software & Bots
collection.description: Application runtimes, Discord bots, APIs and microservices
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: Golang
shard.description: Compiled Go application runner with support for building from Git sources or executing Linux x86_64 prebuilt binaries.
shard.author: Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Go Application Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache git curl ca-certificates go

cd /mnt/server

if [ ! -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "Cloning git repository: ${GIT_ADDRESS}..."
    if [ -z "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
        GIT_BRANCH="main"
    fi
    git clone -b ${GIT_BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    if [ -f "go.mod" ]; then
        echo "Compiling Go application..."
        go build -o "${EXECUTABLE}"
    fi
fi

if [ -f "${EXECUTABLE}" ]; then
    chmod +x "${EXECUTABLE}"
fi

echo "Golang installation completed!"

variables.name: Binary Executable
variables.description: Name of the compiled Go executable.

variables.name: Git Clone Address
variables.description: Optional Git repository URL to clone and build automatically.

variables.name: Additional Arguments
variables.description: Command-line arguments passed to the Go executable.
